mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals an impending monetary tightening that raises discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation and employment growth, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates improving economic conditions that boost corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1400 thousand units indicates weakening demand for residential construction, which signals broader economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of falling federal funds rates and rising unemployment rates signals an active monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which typically precedes positive equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS falls and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rising federal funds rate is a leading indicator of reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when GDPC1 rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises while housing starts (HOUST) fall, it indicates a supply-driven economic slowdown with weak demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
